question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.**
solution: The correct answer is: **Emission** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Emission **means the release of something, usually gas or radiation. (किसी चीज़ का निकलना, आमतौर पर गैस या विकिरण) • **Example**: *The factory implemented measures to reduce carbon emissions.* • The word is commonly used in the context of emissions from vehicles or factories. • In this question, the blank is asking for a noun that fits with the options given, and emission is the most appropriate choice. Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Feeding **refers to the act of providing food. (भोजन उपलब्ध कराने की क्रिया) • **Creation **means the act of bringing something into existence. (किसी चीज़ को अस्तित्व में लाने की क्रिया) • **Fertilisation **refers to the process of combining male and female reproductive cells. (नर और मादा प्रजनन कोशिकाओं के संयोजन की प्रक्रिया) 43:T961, The correct answer is: **Imbalance**.
